summary.zh: 登录页细节与自部署登录流程完善：修复自定义客户端直连交换的解析错误，弹框保存后直接进入登录。
summary.en: Login page polish and self-hosted flow completion: fixed a parse error in direct client exchange, and the sheet now signs in right after saving.

items.zh: 修复配置自定义 OAuth 客户端后授权交换失败的问题（GitHub 返回格式解析错误）
items.en: Fixed the exchange failure when a custom OAuth client is configured (GitHub response format parse error)

items.zh: 自部署弹框保存按钮改为「登录」，保存后立即发起完整授权流程
items.en: The sheet's save button is now “Sign in” and immediately starts the full OAuth flow

items.zh: 自部署验证地址输入框默认留空，留空时使用内置后端
items.en: The self-hosted verification URL field starts empty; blank falls back to the built-in backend

items.zh: 登录页「创建新 Token」链接内联到说明文字后，自部署区块增加说明与间隔
items.en: Token link now flows inline after the scopes text; self-hosted section gains a description and spacing

items.zh: 「我」页账号管理区在仅有一个账号时也保持可见，切换账号后立即刷新凭据
items.en: The profile account manager stays visible with a single account; switching now refreshes credentials immediately
